vectors.name: list-intervening-column
vectors.description: A separator between an item's marker and its definition list column cannot continue the list.

vectors.name: outer-marker-column
vectors.description: A separator at the outer item's marker column has left that item.

vectors.name: double-colon
vectors.description: A term marker below a nested definition list's column is also misleading.

vectors.name: quoted-list
vectors.description: A quote prefix does not erase the nested list's authored column.

vectors.name: after-blank
vectors.description: After a blank, a below-column separator has left the item.

vectors.name: nested-item
vectors.description: The innermost surviving item's definition list supplies the target column.

vectors.name: at-list-column
vectors.description: A separator at the definition list column adds a description.

vectors.name: within-description
vectors.description: An indented separator can open a nested definition list inside a description.

vectors.name: escaped-separator
vectors.description: An escaped colon is literal text.

vectors.name: code-payload
vectors.description: A separator-shaped code line is payload, not a separator.

vectors.name: outside-container
vectors.description: A top-level separator-shaped line has no displaced nested list.
